verdicts.reason: A shrinks the owl mascots to tiny, almost invisible icons in the bottom-left corner, so the brand imagery is lost. The text is jammed at the top with a large dead confetti area below, and the red subtitle competes with the headline. B keeps the owls at a meaningful size beside a large, clear three-line headline, so it reads as the same design. Its flaws: 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' is tiny and stranded at the top-left, far from the headline; the top half is mostly empty confetti; and the owl pair is slightly cramped next to the title.
